Academic Profile

Semiconductor-device and optoelectronics researcher specializing in solution-processed organic and perovskite
materials, photovoltaic devices, and self-powered photodetectors. My research combines semiconductor-device physics,
thin-film fabrication, optoelectronic characterization, and interpretable machine learning to understand performance-
limiting mechanisms and guide materials and device optimization. My doctoral work developed data-driven models
using molecular and structural descriptors and experimentally validated predictions in non-fullerene organic solar
cells. My postdoctoral research extends this experience to photodetectors, wide-bandgap perovskite photovoltaics,
radiovoltaic energy conversion, and lightweight photovoltaic devices. I aim to establish an interdisciplinary research
programme in AI/ML-enabled semiconductor devices for energy, sensing, and optical communication.
Research output: 20+ peer-reviewed journal publications; 400+ Google Scholar citations; h-index 13; recipient of
the K. L. Chopra Best Ph.D. Thesis Award.

Proposed Research Programme at LNMIIT

1. AI/ML-Guided Semiconductor Materials and Device Optimization
Development of interpretable machine-learning and Bayesian-optimization approaches for predicting device perfor-
mance, identifying performance-limiting parameters, optimizing fabrication conditions, and improving the performance
and stability of organic and perovskite semiconductor devices. The research will combine experimentally generated
data, physically meaningful descriptors, model interpretation, and experimental validation.

2. Self-Powered Optoelectronic and Energy Devices
Development of organic, perovskite, and hybrid semiconductor devices for broadband sensing, optical communication,
indoor and portable energy harvesting. The research will focus on semiconductor interfaces, charge-generation and
transport mechanisms, spectral response, response speed, operational stability, lightweight device architectures, and
scalable thin-film fabrication.

Research Expertise and Technical Skills

Semiconductor devices and fabrication

• Organic and perovskite solar cells, photodetectors, sensors, and radiovoltaic devices.
• Glovebox processing, spin coating, substrate preparation, interface engineering, thermal evaporation, and multilayer
   thin-film fabrication.
• Large-area and solution-processed semiconductor-device fabrication.

Device and materials characterization

• Current-density–voltage measurements under AM1.5 and AM0 illumination, external quantum efficiency, maximum-
   power-point tracking, and stability testing.
• Transient photocurrent, transient photovoltage, responsivity, detectivity, response-time, and temperature-dependent
   measurements.
• XRD, UV–Vis–NIR absorption, steady-state and time-resolved photoluminescence, and fluorescence spectroscopy.
• Analysis and interpretation of SEM, TEM, AFM, XPS, and Raman data.

Machine learning and scientific data analysis

• Materials informatics, molecular and structural descriptors, feature engineering, regression, model validation, and
   interpretation.
• Bayesian optimization for materials, fabrication processes, and device-performance optimization.
• Python-based scientific analysis using NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and Matplotlib.

Radiovoltaic measurements

• Radiation-source handling, device integration, electrical measurement, and evaluation of radiation-to-electrical
   energy conversion.
